description: Default runtime configuration generation for assorted tracing-collector host values (hostname with dots, IP address, host carrying an explicit port).

cases.expected_output:
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Configuration
metadata:
  name: daprConfig
spec:
  tracing:
    samplingRate: "1"
    zipkin:
      endpointAddress: http://zipkin.observability.svc.cluster.local:9411/api/v2/spans

apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Configuration
metadata:
  name: daprConfig
spec:
  tracing:
    samplingRate: "1"
    zipkin:
      endpointAddress: http://10.0.0.5:9411/api/v2/spans

apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Configuration
metadata:
  name: daprConfig
spec:
  tracing:
    samplingRate: "1"
    zipkin:
      endpointAddress: http://myhost:1234:9411/api/v2/spans
